notes.title: Play Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition Demo Today!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Sire![/h2]
[h3]Gird your loins and sharpen your steel because 23 years after it first launched, we’re incredibly excited to announce Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition![/h3]

Travel back in time to the legendary crusades for the holy land in this new expanded definitive edition, releasing this year on July 15th 2025 with brand new content, elevated graphics and extensive player-requested features all rebuilt by game’s original developers!

This title is many people’s favourite old-school 2D RTS, so taking this cult favourite and elevating it for the modern player has been an endeavour of passion for us – one that is only possible because of the community’s clear desire for this kind of classic strategy experience. The best way we could think of thanking you for your support has been to go above and beyond, with new AIs, missions, modes and maps, as well as the Steam multiplayer and workshop integrations that the original could never have had.

What better way to kick off the Steam RTS Fest than a demo of this reinvented gem, heralded with a shiny new reveal trailer, masterfully scored by the legendary bard of Stronghold himself, Robert L. Euvino! This trailer showcases the depth of work and love poured into the remaster. We really hope you enjoy it!

Flex your might against 20 challenging AI lords, charge through the new co-op trail with a friend or dive into skirmish mode featuring larger maps, custom options and quality of life fixes – Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition allows you to revisit a reimagined strategy classic and play exactly the way you want to!

[h3]Wishlist Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition now on Steam ahead of the game’s full release on July 15th 2025 and play the demo right now![/h3]

notes.title: Lunar Map Pack
notes.content:
[h1]Now Available on Steam Workshop[/h1]

To celebrate the Lunar New Year Sale we've created four new maps for Space Colony! Accessible via Steam Workshop, each map was created by a different team member to present a unique challenge:

[b]Four New Maps[/b]
[list][*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=621537708][b]Intrepid[/b][/url] - VL-537 attracted many colonists in the early years due to its green landscapes, beautiful canyons and Earth-like ability to provide for settlers. Unfortunately recent rumors of colonists disappearing and entirely unrelated budget cuts mean that we can't offer much financial support. Given the circumstances all we ask is that you read the guide book and follow standard procedure. We just hope the planet lets you...

[*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=621531789][b]Desert Loners[/b][/url] - Welcome to Desert Loners! The bad news is that your ship has crash-landed on a strange moon. You are struggling to survive and a nearby asteroid belt, along with your history of gambling debts, means rescue is highly unlikely. The good news? Both you and your team of misfits are still breathing! If you do manage to beat the odds and survive there may a future among the stars for your motley crew.

[*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=621578612][b]Be Brave[/b][/url] - Destined to be the most important 'red planet' in the known universe, this new discovery is filled with precious resources and ample colony-friendly vegetation. Less friendly are the local extraterrestrial inhabitants, fiercely protective of their nest. A successful colonist is a breathing colonist, so build defenses and erect laser towers before venturing out into the unknown. Patiently explore the planet and you might just return both rich and alive!

[*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=621523777][b]Subjugate[/b][/url] - It has been several decades now since our company last discovered an Earth-type planet with the required ecological balance to sustain life without any terraforming. A recent report from your scouting team suggests they have pinpointed the location of a new Class-M habitable planet. We know that communication has since fallen silent, but believe this is simply due to interference caused by debris in the planet's upper atmosphere. We also know what you're thinking, however there is no evidence to suggest hostile a alien threat. So get your team on site and take control of the situation before our rivals do![/list]

We hope you enjoy the new maps and the rest of the Steam Sale!

[b]Please Note[/b] - These new maps are not included in the base game and must be downloaded separately via Steam Workshop using the links above.

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Fixes and Tweaks - 8 May 2015[/h1]

[b]Change Log[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where some players were unable to scroll around the map.
[*]Removed legacy references to DirectPlay that may have been causing some issues on Windows 8.1.
[*]The launcher now looks for Steam Workshop files in the Steam folder rather than transferring them to the Documents\Space Colony folder.
[*]Added extra Steam Workshop functionality to enable creators to update their Workshop items.
[*]Fixed Stair Climber entry in English help file.
[*]Added log file output to help debug startup issues.[/list]

notes.title: Launch Week
notes.content:
[h1]Release Date, Trailer and New Features[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yO7KRWasma0

[b]Release Date[/b]

Launch week is finally here! Developed and self-published by the folks here at Firefly, [i]Space Colony: Steam Edition[/i] is a remaster of the original sci-fi base builder. It will expand the core game with new missions and features, releasing exclusively on Steam on April 30th.

[b]What is Space Colony?[/b]

Space Colony is the cult classic sci-fi base builder from Firefly Studios, creators of the Stronghold series. As a commander of military and commercial installations on Earth, Blackwater Industries wants to see how you handle the rest of the galaxy. In Space Colony both your career and life are in the hands of an unruly crew, all looking to escape life back on Earth. Choosing from more than 100 different buildings, it’s up to you to design and build a colony that meets the needs of your crew keeping them safe, happy and alive. Half way across the galaxy with limited resources, a mega corporation looking over your shoulder and a ragtag crew expecting a paycheck, it's up to you to survive and turn a profit.

[b]Key Features[/b]

First unveiled at EGX Rezzed in London, [i]Space Colony: Steam Edition[/i] is faithful to the original game with military and civilian campaigns containing more than 80 missions and brand new single player content. Steam Workshop functionality also has been added to the map editor, allowing you to share custom maps with the Steam community. Discover old favorites, upload new creations and even download whole new campaigns designed by the Space Colony community!

Created exclusively for Steam, this new remastered version includes a number of new Steam features such as achievements, trading cards and Steam Cloud for saved games. [i]Space Colony: Steam Edition[/i] is the definitive version for fans of the original game, the Stronghold series and connoisseurs of isometric sci-fi base builder management sims. Also supported are high resolution graphics settings, allowing players to view their entire colony while playing on a single screen.
